build_bart_agent: build a BART agent using the BartAgent class with --init-model zoo:bart/bart_large/model
convert_fairseq_to_parlai: convert a fairseq BART checkpoint to a ParlAI model using --init-fairseq-model
add_bart_cmdline_args: add BART-specific command line arguments like --init-fairseq-model to a ParlaiParser
build_bart_model: build a BartModel instance with optional pre-trained embeddings via build_model
set_text_vec_with_tokens: set text vectors with start and end tokens prepended and appended for BART encoding
